parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The AppName of the live stream.

parameters.name: CreateTimestampList
parameters.description: A list of timestamps of the snapshots to delete.

parameters.name: RemoveFile
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to also delete the snapshot files from OSS. Valid values:

- **true**: Deletes.

- **false**: Does not delete.

> To delete files from OSS, you must have the required permissions for OSS file operations.
